title: Account is not allowed to log on from there or then

support.label: one host carries at least 80% of failures

next_steps: Confirm that {account} is meant to be used from {top_host}. If not, stop using it there.
If it is meant to work from {top_host}, ask the identity team to review the account's logon restrictions through the standard request path.
Do not reset the password. It is not the cause.
